subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should the experimental Claw package-owner slice land before RFC acceptance with plugin-only executable preflight and warning-only shared-plugin removal?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically, but whether this partial package contract and landing order are acceptable belongs to the still-open RFC and assigned product review.

options.title: Finish the RFC contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open until trust is plan-bound, skill scope is resolved, real package proof is supplied, and the RFC owner approves the landing order.

options.title: Narrow to plugin-only
options.body: Explicitly make this a plugin-only experimental slice, remove or defer unreachable skill installation code, and document the later skill owner contract.

options.title: Pause the package stack
options.body: Defer this and dependent lifecycle PRs until shared package ownership, removal, and recovery semantics are settled in the RFC.

recommendation.title: Finish the RFC contract first
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until trust is plan-bound, skill scope is resolved, real package proof is supplied, and the RFC owner approves the landing order.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and authored the concrete ownership and removal requirements now governing this slice.
